summary: Tested multi-photo arrays (birthmark, mgnv, knuckles/anchor, attachments/HOA, underground) and combined Poles+Underground reorder feature. All 7 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend Job Detail shows unified 'Poles & Underground (2 poles, 2 UG)' list with working Reorder mode (Drag items to reorder), PoleForm uses MultiPhotoUpload for Birthmark/MGNV/HOA/Anchor while OCALC L/M/R remain single PhotoUpload, Additional Photos section is fully removed, and UndergroundForm uses MultiPhotoUpload.
critical_code_review_comments: Reorder UI uses dnd-kit but no visible drag handle data-testid was found on sortable items (drag-handle/sortable testids absent). Items still drag via the row, but adding data-testid='drag-handle-{id}' would improve automated drag-and-drop test coverage.

PUT /api/jobs/{job_id}/reorder-items silently skips items missing 'type', 'id', or 'sort_order' (returns 200 with zero counts). Consider returning 400 with diagnostic message if all items are malformed - currently a typo client side could result in silent no-op.
services/helpers.py:pole_photo_items handles legacy birthmark_photo / mgnv_photo / knuckle.photo / attachment.photo fallbacks correctly - verified via unit-level test.
/api/poles/{id}/gallery and /api/jobs/{id}/photos still grant public access when no token is supplied (carried over from prior iteration) - flag for product to confirm intent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (combined list + reorder UI + form fields all verified)
